headline: Argentine beef export revenues surge 36.9% to $3.79 billion
summary: According to the Consortium of Argentine Beef Exporters (ABC), refrigerated and frozen beef shipments between January and September increased by 36.9% in foreign exchange value, driven by higher prices per ton.
why: Agricultural exports are a crucial source of foreign exchange reserves for Argentina's economy and heavily impact trade balance data.
